Bumps [lucide-react](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/HEAD/packages/lucide-react) from 1.23.0 to 1.24.0.
Release notes

Sourced from lucide-react's releases.

Version 1.24.0

What's Changed

  • fix(scripts): fix typo in renameIcon.function.mts by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4514
  • chore(icons): remove toBeRemovedInVersion metadata and make it optional in schema by @​ericfennis with @​Copilot in lucide-icons/lucide#4513
  • feat(site): Add merch link by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4524
  • fix(packages/angular): move child rendering logic to template from effect by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4519
  • docs(site): list @​gyeonghokim/lucide-lit as third-party package by @​GyeongHoKim in lucide-icons/lucide#4421
  • fix(icons): changed option icon by @​jamiemlaw in lucide-icons/lucide#4326
  • fix(lucide-react-native): restore the icons entry point in the JS bundles by @​pvinis in lucide-icons/lucide#4528
  • fix(vue): support kebab-case icon-node prop on Icon component by @​Sagargupta16 in lucide-icons/lucide#4512
  • fix(lucide-react-native): Add icon exports property to the package.json file by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4522
  • fix(icons): centered the dot icon by @​cnlancehu in lucide-icons/lucide#4492
  • feat(icons): added circle-euro-sign icon by @​Guido3000 in lucide-icons/lucide#4353
  • feat(icons): added server-plus icon by @​Turboman3000 in lucide-icons/lucide#4232

New Contributors

  • @​ericfennis with @​Copilot made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4513
  • @​GyeongHoKim made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4421
  • @​pvinis made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4528
  • @​Sagargupta16 made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4512
  • @​Guido3000 made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4353
  • @​Turboman3000 made their first contribution in lucide-icons/lucide#4232

Full Changelog: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/compare/1.23.0...1.24.0
